mission.goal: Implement consequential functional gaps after reading the comprehensive plan and beads; publish meaningful checkpoints directly to main through GitHub without PRs.

FSS-203/FSS-204 live session expiry and durable recovery slice

published_checkpoints.change: Bounded native Matroska AVC/HEVC initialization parameters through fss-probe.
Closed ONNX opset-17 import profile and native ordered-F32 LayerNormalization lowering.
Explicit live session clock, durable expiry/refusal checkpoints, deadline-aware follow/probe/handoff and existing replay preservation.

authority.user: Implement and commit directly to main using GitHub; no PRs.
authority.scope: Repository code, retained deterministic fixtures and local verification. No live device operations or outbound effects.
authority.release: Repository-owned local qualification and retained DSR receipts remain required.

cases.finding: Native Matroska demux existed but bounded video-parameter inspection did not admit its AVC/HEVC codec-private records.
cases.resolution: Reuse native EBML/track/CRC and AVC/HEVC owners under finite prefix/element/track/NAL limits.

cases.finding: The importer only admitted opset 13; LayerNormalization and versioned opset-17 inference forms were unavailable.
cases.resolution: Add a closed version profile and bounded lowering through existing arithmetic owners, preserving separately rounded F32 reciprocal and multiplication.

cases.finding: Live session authority could follow a frozen evidence clock while the deployment remained quiet.
cases.resolution: Pass trusted runtime time independently of evidence time; persist admitted watermarks and expired tombstones across commands and recovery.

cases.finding: A case deadline could expire after native work completed but before its result was linked.
cases.resolution: Revalidate fresh case/session deadlines under the citation owner while preserving native record adjacency and charged work.

findings: Existing MP4/Annex-B behavior and retained parameter spans are preserved; Matroska results do not claim media decoding, timing or custody.
ONNX support remains a closed static F32 import profile, not arbitrary trained-model compatibility. Model IR operators and wire format are unchanged.
Live session reads may append a private clock checkpoint while workspaces, grants, token spend and evidence remain unchanged.
Exact open retry, cold recovery and handoff do not restart a session lease or replenish a budget.

Relative case/claim opening retries retain their original deadlines after progress. New live feedback binds admission time and preserves its original timestamp on exact retry, keeping historical evidence independent of current review deadlines.
No Cargo dependency, feature, toolchain pin or release gate was changed.
invalidations: Live CLI/MCP admission no longer uses committed evidence time. Historical reference sessions in an old clock domain are not migrated or renewed; explicit path APIs retain deterministic replay.
Journal byte identity is no longer the successful live session-read contract; immutable semantic state plus monotonic private clock admission is the contract.
Two dependency build failures prevent claiming reference/CLI compilation or new session test execution.

budgets.session: Existing original lease, narrowed grants, cumulative token charges and native attempt accounting persist without renewal or refill.
